name: packs
description: The PWFabric foundation and widgets packs: the block vocabulary every PWFabric app is built from.

scripts.generate: node tools/apply-pack-map.mjs && node tools/generators/build-icons.mjs && node tools/generators/derive-mobile-collapse.mjs --pack packs/foundation
